title: Order of the Divine Bird Knights
text: “Right now, the entire nation is on high alert and searching for him.”

“Maybe we should tell Ren and Itsuki to report back when they get home so they can help with the search. Motoyasu, use Filolial—not to mention the monsters, Raph-chan, and Keel—to track him down, even if it means combing through every blade of grass!”
“Y-yes! But Keel-kun is out on a long trip, so please ask another kid with a good nose.”
So, we split up to search for Trash. But we couldn’t find him. Father speculated that he must have used his portal skill to escape, anticipating that we’d track him by scent.

You bastard, Trash! To think he’s bounced back after breaking so many hearts—he’s a monster! No matter how far Motoyasu runs, I’ll make sure he gets his comeuppance. Hahaha… I’m going to take this opportunity to kill you in the most gruesome way possible!
With that in mind, we continued our search for Trash… but we never found him.
“I don’t know if he’s just good at escaping or what… Is this also the work of the guy behind the reincarnated ones and Bitch? Damn…”
My father was getting frustrated at not being able to find Trash.
“Where the hell did Ren and Itsuki go at a time like this? This is a perfect chance for the heroes to spring into action.”
“We’ve received some promising leads from the neighboring country, so I’ll explain it when we get back to the village.”

And so, the search continued while the days passed. Ren and Itsuki must have gotten bored with the life in my Father’s village, because they stopped coming by altogether. There have been reports from various places—through rumors and such—that people have spotted someone who looks like them…
It’s the heroes accompanied by Filolial-sama. So I know they’re out there, but Ren, Itsuki… and even Fleon-chan are out and about as well. It’s a bit worrisome…

Despite that sense of unease, the days passed without any particular problems. Yuki-chan and the others were full of energy, and Filo-tan was having a great time with her Finacée. Father and my sister seem to be getting along better than ever before, even compared to previous loops. And with Big Sister summoning a Panda to play with her, and her grandfather being introduced to the old woman, the village grew livelier and livelier.
Eventually, the day of the final wave arrived. During this time, I was so on edge that I raced all over the world with Yuki-chan in Drive Mode.
“Ugh… Fleon-chan…”
“Motoyasu, calm down… I get that you’re worried about where Ren, Itsuki, and Trash have gone…”
That’s right. We’d completely lost track of where Ren and Itsuki had gone. Ah, Ren’s companions are also missing.

As for the Filolial Heroes abroad, the truth has come to light: the stories were a jumble of rumors—like Keel imitating Ren and capturing villains alongside Luna-chan, or Filo-tan hunting down bandits with her Finacée. What’s more, the whereabouts of Fleon-chan and the others are unknown as well. There’s no sign that the Monster Mark has been lifted, yet they remain out of range.

As for Ren and Itsuki, I’ve heard that an investigation by the Four Holy Churches has confirmed they aren’t dead—but when reincarnated individuals are involved, even that can’t be trusted. Still… Ren and Itsuki had already completed all the enhancements to their Holy Weapons. They’re on a whole other level—even if a reincarnated person were to punch them while they’re sleeping, they wouldn’t even sustain a scratch, let alone a mosquito bite. What a headache…
“I think this is punishment for all of us having fun together.”
“Raphtalia’s been harsher on Motoyasu lately.”
“Raph—”
Her Father affectionately strokes Big Sister’s head.
“W-well, I do have some reasons to be grateful, but the fact is, I can’t forgive him!”
“Hmm?”
“Raph—she says she hates Kitamura.”
“It’s pretty spoiled of you to be getting petted by Master thanks to Urushu-san.”
Kou and Filo-tan are having a heartwarming exchange.
“Well… the Spear Hero does tend to go a bit overboard sometimes. After all, look what happened to Raphtalia.”
The Finacée is now taking on the waves alongside her Father. She’s transforming alongside Filo-tan, isn’t she?
“Big Sister, if you hate having Big Bro pay so much attention to you, why don’t you just stay in your Demi-Human form?”

Big Sister’s tail is swaying unnaturally at Tiger Guy’s suggestion. She’s staying in that form on purpose because she’s not entirely opposed to it! Tiger Guy might not understand, but a maiden’s heart is complex, you know.
“Oh my—Raphtalia-chan is complicated too, isn’t she?”
“Raph-fu.”
“Raph-chan, please don’t laugh! It’s all your fault, after all!”
“Raph-u.”
As if to say, “Glad to see you’re doing well!” the Raph-species is cheering on her Big Sister.
“Either way, this is the last wave for the strategy guide and the guidebook discussion. Everyone! Let’s buckle down and get this done!”
“I guess this wraps up my part of the job for now.”
With that in mind, Tiger Guy clenched his fists in preparation for battle. Soon, the wave countdown reached zero, and we teleported to the location of the final wave.

……Huh? The reactions from Fleon-chan and Black Thunder, which had been cut off, are back, aren’t they? Just as I was thinking that, monsters began emerging from the wave’s fissure, and as is customary every loop, the reincarnated folks—
“Hey, hey, hurry up! Otherwise we won’t be able to escape!”
“Shut up! I’m in the middle of something right now!”
“We’ve got to escape to another world—anywhere—and get stronger! Move out of the way already!”
“You’re in the way! They’re coming!”
All of a sudden, the reincarnated folks are sticking their heads out of the rift as if they’ve been cornered. They seem to be in a pretty desperate situation, though.
“Hello there, hello there. Are you folks from that world? Do you mean us any harm—”

The reincarnated ones were trying to negotiate with us in a somewhat friendly manner, as if asking for help… though their attitude made it clear they were looking down on us. Just as they were about to wave at us… the wave-like crack turned pitch black, and space warped.
“Gyaa—!?”
“Whoa—!?”
“Oink—!?”

The pig that had slipped in alongside the reincarnated ones vanished into the spatial distortion as well… and the wave ended instantly. It ended in the blink of an eye, sweeping up even the monsters emerging from the crack.
“What was that just now?”
“Um… does that mean Gaelion-san cornered them over there and annihilated those ‘Tenseisha’ folks at the last moment…?”
“What do you think? Motoyasu, do you have any idea?”
“It’s the first time I’ve ever seen a spatial wave like that. Also, when that wave happened just now, I noticed a reaction from Fleon-chan and the others.”
Could it be that Fleon-chan and the others were in that other world…? Since the wave has ended, that means they’ve been left behind!
Rival! I see you were carrying Tsume’s Seven Star Weapons. I’ll definitely bring Fleon-chan and the others back here with me—and you, you’ll be left to live out your days in that world forever!
“What? That brainwashed Filolial?”
At my words, my Father put his hand to his mouth as if deep in thought and stared intently at the spot where the crack had been.
Soon after… accompanied by a whoosh of wind, a ship appeared in the air.

That ship looks familiar. I’m pretty sure it’s that “Vassal Weapon”—the one that the Rough species… Raph-chan—became the owner of in the first world. Hmm? Fleon and the others are reacting again. The ship gradually descended and landed right in front of us.
“I’m back… I’m home…”
Rival stepped out of the ship with a puzzled expression. That’s a rare reaction, though.
“It’s not Gaelion. Welcome back.”
The Assistant steps forward to greet Rival.
“I’m back. Big sis, Naofumi.”
“Ah, uh… Is this your doing? A group that looked like reincarnators showed up earlier, but they got caught up in something and vanished.”
“It’s true that I wiped them all out… but…”
The rival glances briefly toward the ship.
“Rival! Has Fleon-chan gone over to your world by any chance? I’m picking up a monster emblem reaction!”
“They were coming in droves. Seriously, just because things have calmed down over here, those guys went and completely messed up Gaelion’s plans!”
As he said this, my Father furrowed his brow and glared at the ship with a grim expression. A swish-swish… sound echoed from the ship as a large group of people approached, and they came into view.
There—
Just as my Father tried to turn and run away in a flash, my Finacée and Big Sister grabbed him by the arms and restrained him.
“Grr… the portal—”
“Wait a minute! What do you think you’re doing, running away?”
“Naofumi-sama, please calm down!”
Held back by my Big Sister and Finacée, my Father—who’d been trying to escape using his portal skill—was called back once more.
“Melty, I’ll leave the rest to you!”
“No way! I’d rather dump this entirely on Mom, so you’re coming too, Naofumi!”
“Ugh… you’re right! In times like this, let’s just dump it on the queen or some other high-ranking official!”
“I’m not so sure about that… I have a feeling it might just make things worse…”
“What the hell are those guys? Bird masks?”
Tiger Guy’s point is a valid one. The group that emerged from the ship was wearing Filolial masks.

I wondered, “Just how many impersonators are there?” but then I spotted Fleon-chan and Black Thunder as well. Oh? Looking closer, Ren and Itsuki are mixed in there too. And Ren’s subordinates are with them as well. I heard later from Father that they’d apparently just been forced to tag along.
Leading this bizarre group is a figure—presumably a man—cloaked in a cape and wearing a metallic Filolial Mask… or rather, an Iron Mask.

“People of another world! Please do not be on your guard! We have not come to fight! We have come to build friendship between our worlds! You there, Shield Heroes—the Shield and the Spear Heroes—we request a meeting with you!”

…A rather mysterious figure is approaching us, trying to build friendship. I’ve never seen a guy like this before—should I just wipe him out with Brionac? Just as I was thinking that, a pig holding a fan descended and made its way over to my Father, forcefully grasping his hand.
“You’re Glass…”
“Bubhibububububu…”
At this point, Yuki-chan translated the fan-pig’s lines for me.

“‘It was Naofumi, wasn’t it… Well, I’ve heard from the Demon King himself about who they are, and it’s true that they’ve helped me in various ways… But I, too, was forced into this partnership against my will… Yes…’ That’s what he said.”
“The Demon King… Ah, I get it. So you snuck in here under the guise of a complaint against me, too?”

“‘It’s not really a complaint, though… It’s true that they helped me. Thanks to these people, I was able to defeat the reincarnated individuals whose ambitions to seize the world were running wild. And it’s also true that I made peace with the Demon King who appeared out of nowhere…’”
What a roundabout way of putting it.

“I was planning to help you guys from the start, you know. I was in the middle of solidifying my position when these guys suddenly rose to power and took over the world in one fell swoop. Power taken too far is no different from violence, but there’s no doubt that power is all about how you use it.”
Rival sighs and shakes his head repeatedly.
“Spear Hero, I’ve realized that if I don’t secure some space for these guys to run wild, they’ll end up pulling stunts like this.”
The Rival’s gaze is fixed on Ren, Itsuki, and the Man in the Iron Mask.
“…So, what exactly are we supposed to do?”
“We just need to talk to them…”
“I really don’t want to get into a heated argument…”
“Otherwise, they’ll just start holding peace talks with every country on their own. No doubt about it. They’ve specifically requested Naofumi.”
“Considering the long-term consequences, I suppose that’s for the best…”
When my father turned his gaze toward the man in the iron mask, the man began to speak with a dignified air.
“I apologize for the delay in introducing myself. My name is Filolial Cross! The one who connects race to race! World to world! And these are those who share my same aspirations.”

Race to race? World to world? A mysterious man who invokes the name of Filolial-sama and goes by the name Cross. What a strangely energetic bunch they are. Fleon-chan is also aboard the ship striking a peculiar pose alongside Black Thunder.

“Our name is the Divine Bird Knights! O heroes who seek to shoulder the weight of the world! We are your allies! Whether you be human, Demi-Human, spirit, or whatever you may be… I, Filolial Cross, believe we can walk this path together!”
The Father has that cat-like expression against a space backdrop for the first time in a while. Maybe that’s just a characteristic of the Father in this world.

“But! Those who falsely claim to be gods and those who have received their blessing have despicably schemed behind the scenes throughout history, sparking meaningless conflicts! Therefore, we have made them pay the price!”
That’s some seriously speech-like dialogue, isn’t it?

“We do not consider fighting to be evil. Let us swear to devote ourselves to peace, to justice, and to a world free of discrimination! If reincarnated beings disrupt the world and cause suffering to the people, we will rush to the scene immediately and pass Judgment—no matter how powerful they may be! We, the Divine Bird Knights, will not yield! In the name of this Filolial Cross, we will continue to seek a world free of discrimination for the sake of true peace!”
“‘Cross! Cross! Cross! Kueeeeee!’”
It’s “Kuee!”—that’s right! In unison with the Divine Bird Knights’ chant, I struck a pose inspired by the fierce Filolial-sama.
